title: Executive at Professional Services Firm Expects DocuSign Services to Grow 10%–15% in 2026 as AI Workflow Demand Rises
expert: Senior leader at a professional-services consulting firm; Docusign at least 30% of relevant platform activity; sees implementation billings first-hand
verdict: The expert's Docusign-related services revenue grew about 10% y/y in Aug–Oct 2026 on AI and document-automation projects, while customer spend at renewal is generally flat to up no more than 5% as seat cuts offset higher tiers.

Back to double-digit growth: 🟢 **Services up about 10% y/y**, 10%–15% expected for CY26 (estimate); in line with +~10.2% on the 2026-11-09 VAR AE call.
DBNR / renewal expansion: 🟡 **Customer spend flat to up no more than 5%** at renewal (estimate); seats flat or slightly down vs +~11% on the 2026-11-09 call: **conflicting**.
🔴 **Downgrades up around 5%** (estimate) as some customers consolidate onto Adobe, vs no meaningful churn on 2026-11-09: **conflicting**.
IAM adoption: 🟢 **CLM and AI workflow adoption up 30%–40%** (estimate) vs close to 15% on the 2026-11-06 consulting call and Cleveland's soft CLM read (SB #63588): **conflicting**.
🟢 **Usage up an estimated 15%-20%** as AI runs higher-volume workflows; matches 15%–20% on the 2026-11-05 consulting PMO call.

changes: Services +~10% and CY26 10%–15% (estimate) vs +~10.2% and ~10% CY26 (2026-11-09, VAR AE): consistent.
Seats flat to slightly down vs +~11% (2026-11-09, VAR AE): conflicting.
CLM adoption +30%–40% (estimate) vs close to 15% (2026-11-06, consulting strategist) and Cleveland net-new CLM down Y/Y (SB #63588): conflicting.
Downgrades up around 5% (estimate) vs no meaningful churn (2026-11-09, VAR AE): conflicting.
thesis_impact: Stance (neutral; DD growth): ↑ — services +~10% now, 10%–15% for CY26 (estimate).
Stance (IAM bet): ↑ — CLM/AI workflow adoption +30%–40% (estimate), customers moving to higher tiers; seat pressure persists.
